title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
About Blockbrain
For mid-sized companies, knowledge is the last real competitive lever. Yet knowledge gets stuck in tools and SharePoint folders — or disappears when experts leave. While IT is still planning, employees are already using ChatGPT and the like — without governance, and sensitive data is leaking out.
With the Knowledge Bots platform, Blockbrain creates what companies truly need: AI-powered knowledge management that is quick to implement, flexibly scales, and operates in a compliant manner. Teams use our GenAI building blocks to build tailored AI assistants, agents, and workflows in minutes — just like Lego.

- Series A funded with strong growth momentum (10x product usage & 5x revenue in 2025)
- Enterprise clients such as Roland Berger, Bosch, IONOS, and Harting from industries including manufacturing, finance, and legal — sectors with the highest security requirements
- ISO 27001 certified, EU AI Act ready. Made in Germany.


About the role
Forward Deployed Engineers are the people who turn a signed contract into a working system. You are embedded directly in client environments, writing production code, designing integrations, and making technical calls on-site. You own the gap between what a customer wants and what actually runs.
This is not a support role and not a sell-and-specify role. This is where you build, ship, and see your impact land the same week. You sit across from client engineering teams one day and feed real signal back to our Product and Engineering teams the next. If you love building, own your decisions, and can carry a technical conversation from a junior dev to a CTO, this is for you. Real ownership from day one.


Your Profile: 

- 5+ years in solutions engineering, full-stack development, or a client-facing technical role, with proven ability to deliver projects from ideation to deployment
- Strong TypeScript proficiency across the stack and a jack-of-all-trades attitude, eager to pick up new technologies and infrastructure fast. Familiarity with LLMs, data processing, and coding agents is ideal
- Hands-on with the full toolbox: TypeScript/Node.js, Python, REST, GraphQL, Kubernetes, Docker, ArgoCD, Terraform, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, vector databases, LLM/embedding pipelines, and CI/CD tooling (Sentry, Grafana, Datadog)
- A bias for action: you prototype rapidly, deliver value quickly, and thrive in ambiguous, dynamic environments
- Clear communication across all levels, confident leading consultations, demos, and technical workshops with everyone from engineers to decision-makers
- Entrepreneurial and self-directed: you juggle multiple client engagements, coordinate across teams, and keep deployments on track without external project management
- Fluent English and German at least at B2 level


Expected AI Skills
At Blockbrain, AI is not a buzzword, it is how we work every day and a real lever in the field.

- Use Claude Code and Blockbrain's own agents to accelerate deployments, scaffolding integrations, debugging client environments, and generating documentation instead of writing everything from scratch
- As the person closest to how customers actually use the platform, feed real field feedback back to Product and reach for new AI tools reflexively, if something cuts a 2-day integration task to 2 hours, you find it
We are not looking for AI researchers, but for engineers who treat AI as a power tool and use it before doing things the slow way.


Your Mission

- Own end-to-end delivery of Blockbrain in client environments, from infrastructure standup through agent configuration, retrieval tuning, and integration wiring, working directly with client engineering teams
- Build client-specific extensions: custom connectors, API adapters, and workflow extensions using our stack (TypeScript/Node.js, Python/FastAPI, Next.js), tailored to client data models, auth systems, and business processes
- Configure and optimize our knowledge retrieval layer (vector indexes, reranker pipelines, graph integrations) and translate domain requirements into retrieval architecture decisions
- Support and troubleshoot Kubernetes-based deployments (Docker, ArgoCD), cloud integrations, and IaC (Terraform), taking full ownership of clients running self-hosted instances
- Act as the direct signal channel from the field to Product and Engineering, documenting patterns, edge cases, and missing capabilities specific enough to become actionable backlog
- Lead discovery sessions, integration workshops, and architecture reviews, owning the technical narrative in client meetings and turning customer advocates into platform experts


What Blockbrain Offers

- Flexible Work Models: Full-time position on-site in Stuttgart, Munich or Hamburg (3 days per week) with flexible working hours.
- Benefits: Deutschland-Ticket, Wellpass fitness membership, access to the latest AI tools, and regular company and team off-sites.
- Top Team: International team with exceptional talents.
- High Growth Potential: Steep

Die PTA ist seit 1969 IT-Beratungspartner für Unternehmen aus Branchen wie Versicherung, Energie und Handel. **Worum es geht?**
KI braucht ein Fundament. Sie bauen es.
Unternehmen wollen KI produktiv nutzen und scheitern dabei oft an ihren Daten. Genau dort setzen Sie an: nicht beim Chatbot, sondern beim belastbaren Datenfundament darunter. Sie verstehen Datenplattformen und Datenströme in der Tiefe, bauen und betreiben sie mit KI-Agenten effizienter und machen sie für KI-Anwendungen nutzbar.

### Ihre Aufgaben

- **Kunden beraten:** Sie denken sich in die Fachlichkeit und Datenlandschaft immer neuer Kunden ein, verstehen deren Ziele und beraten sie bei Produktauswahl, Migrationspfaden und Zielbild.
- **Datenplattformen bauen:** Sie konzipieren Data Warehouses, Data Lakes und Lakehouses, on premises oder in der Cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP), bauen sie auf und entwickeln sie weiter, vom Ingest bis zur Bereitstellung für Fachbereiche, Reporting und KI-Anwendungen.
- **Datenströme gestalten:** Sie entwerfen zeitgesteuerte und eventgetriebene Datenströme zwischen operativen Systemen und Plattform (ETL/ELT, Streaming, Schnittstellen). Je nach Projekt arbeiten Sie mal stärker an der Plattform, mal an den Datenströmen und wachsen so in beide Welten hinein.
- **Performance sichern:** Sie legen transaktionale (OLTP) und analytische Systeme (OLAP) so aus, dass sie auch unter Last und bei großen Datenmengen zuverlässig laufen, und analysieren Engpässe gezielt.
- **KI-gestützt entwickeln:** Pipelines, Transformationen, Tests und Migrationen setzen Sie spezifikationsgetrieben mit KI-Agenten wie Claude Code, GitHub Copilot oder Codex um, automatisiert über CI/CD. Mit Tests, Reviews und Datenqualitätsprüfungen sorgen Sie dafür, dass die Ergebnisse fachlich und technisch überzeugen.
- **Daten für Agenten erschließen:** Sie bauen semantische Schichten, Metadaten und Zugänge wie MCP-Server oder CLI-Werkzeuge, nutzen die KI-Funktionen der Datenplattformen und binden bei Bedarf auch unstrukturierte Dokumente an (RAG). Im Datenbetrieb führen Sie agentische Automatisierung ein, etwa für Datenqualität, Monitoring und Fehleranalyse, mit klaren Leitplanken für Rechte, Kosten und Nachvollziehbarkeit.
